claim_text: Testing with municipal recycling facilities validated that K-Cup pods could be effectively recycled.

evidence.text: Two large recycling companies reported significant concerns about commercial feasibility and did not intend to accept the pods.
The SEC order found the 2019 and 2020 statements incomplete and inaccurate because the negative feedback was omitted.

label: CONTRADICTED
adjudication_scope: Do not generalize this finding to every current K-Cup product or every jurisdiction.

claim_text: ESG risks, opportunities and issues were considered throughout the research process via proprietary quality reviews.

evidence.text: 67 of 185 investments in one Overlay Fund lacked an ESG quality-review score at the relevant time, nearly 25% of net assets.
The SEC order found that prospectus language could lead a reasonable investor to believe all holdings had been reviewed, when they had not.

label: CONTRADICTED
adjudication_scope: The order concerns specified funds, statements and period, not all BNY products.

claim_text: ESG was integrated across investment teams and the ESG Engine was used to make portfolio decisions.

evidence.text: The SEC order found inconsistent documented compliance and inadequate implementation of ESG integration policy requirements.
The order states DWS lacked formalized controls to verify use of the ESG Engine and documentation of material ESG factors.

label: CONTRADICTED
adjudication_scope: Use the SEC order for the adjudicated claim; treat 2023 report as post-remediation control.

claim_text: Join us in creating a more sustainable future.

evidence.text: The court found 15 of 19 assessed environmental statements misleading, including vague claims and overly positive presentation of SAF and reforestation.
The annual report says KLM continued the Fly Responsibly campaign and set targets for further CO2 and noise reduction.

label: CONTRADICTED
adjudication_scope: The judgment concerned specific past advertisements, not every KLM sustainability statement.
